title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata OTT release: When and where to watch Kangana Ranaut film, which collected only ₹8 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata OTT rollout: Manoj Tapadia’s Kangana Ranaut -starrer Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata was rolled out in theatres on June 12 to favourable reviews but failed to make a mark at the ticket-window. The movie, based on the events of the 26/11 terror attacks, will soon stream online. Know when and where to watch it.

Adding to this, Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata OTT rollout: Kangana Ranaut played the lead and produced it. When and where to watch Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata will be available to stream on Zee5 from August 15. The OTT platform rolled out a new trailer to make the announcement on Friday, writing, “An untold story of ordinary nurses who stood with extraordinary courage on the darkest night of 26/11. Some heroes were never seen. Their stories were never told. Until now. Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata Trailer Out Now. #BharatBhhagyaViddhaata premieres on 14th Aug on Hindi Zee 5.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Zee 5 (@zee5)

Notably, Talking about the movie, Kangana shared in a note, “Some stories choose you because they deserve to be told. Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata is one such movie. As both an star and producer, it was incredibly important for me to bring to life the untold stories of the healthcare workers who stood fearlessly between terror and humanity during the 26/11 attacks.”

As per the latest buzz, She also added, “Their courage wasn't driven by recognition, but by an unwavering sense of duty and compassion. Releasing this movie around Independence Day makes its message even more meaningful, as it reminds us that the spirit of India is defined not only by those who defend the nation on the frontlines, but also by ordinary citizens who rise to extraordinary challenges in moments of crisis.”

In further updates, “From the very beginning, our intention was to tell the story of 26/11 from a perspective that has never been explored. While the nation remembers the bravery of our security forces, there were equally extraordinary acts of courage unfolding inside Cama Hospital that night. Doctors, nurses and hospital staff continued to care for their patients despite the immense danger surrounding them,” shared Manoj.

On top of that, Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata is written and directed by Manoj Tapadia and produced by PEN Studios, Manikarnika Films and Paramhans Creations in association with Eunoia Films LLP and Floating Rocks Entertainment Pvt Ltd. It stars Kangana Ranaut alongside Girija Oak and Smita Tambe, among others. body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

While she congratulated Mini Mathur for winning the show, one particular photo won hearts online. body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari on Friday morning visited veteran star and BJP leader Mithun Chakraborty at a private hospital in Kolkata, where he underwent a surgical procedure, sources at the medical establishment shared.

title: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's Ramayana aims for a colossal 59,000 screens worldwide, set to beat Avatar, Pushpa The Rule and RRR
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana : Part 1 is turning out to be one of the most ambitious movies ever produced in India. Featuring Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi in the lead roles, the mythological epic does not just intend to make a mark by sheer scale but even by its never seen before global rollout plan. If things proceed as planned, the movie can turn out to be the biggest global theatrical rollout for any Indian movie ever.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana could become the widest-rolled out Indian movie ever with 59,000 screens. A worldwide rollout on an unprecedented scale According to a report in trade tracker Sacnilk, t he producers have plans to launch this movie on more than 59,000 screens through their global theatrical launch. Sony Pictures is responsible for the international distribution of this movie and aims to rollout Ramayana: Part 1 on more than 50,000 screens globally . In India, the movie will be launched on roughly 9,000 screens.

Meanwhile, If all goes according to the plan, this massive number of screens will easily beat those of some recent Indian movies like Pushpa: The Rule, which had its worldwide rollout on approximately 12,000-13,000 screens, and RRR, which was launched on about 10,000-11,000 screens worldwide.

Notably, Ramayana may also surpass Hollywood blockbusters like James Cameron's Avatar: The Way of Water which was rolled out on almost 52,000 screens around the globe and went on to gross more than $2.33 billion at the global ticket-window. The movie will also be out in premium versions, including IMAX.

As per the latest buzz, The trailer of this movie was officially launched on July 30 at Brahma Muhurat. Launched in Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, and Malayalam apart from English dub, this trailer managed to garner more than one billion cumulative views in just five days.

In further updates, Reacting to the response, Namit Malhotra told ANI, “The trailer was rolled out last week and I think it crossed over a billion views in five days, which is a great moment for India. I really appreciate all the love we've got from people all over the world. The aspiration is to now take it to the world as we are with our partnership with Sony Pictures. We are hoping to make sure that Ramayana now releases globally as a big universal movie.”

On top of that, Speaking about the story's universal appeal, he added, “Every Indian, every person in the world I feel can identify with it in some form and shape, so the fact that we're getting appreciation for it and it's connecting with people, that's a feeling of great satisfaction that we are on the right track.”

Produced by Prime Focus Studios and Monster Mind Creations, the movie stars Ranbir Kapoor (Lord Rama and Lord Parshurama), Sai Pallavi (Goddess Sita), Yash (Ravana), Sunny Deol (Lord Hanuman), Ravi Dubey (Lakshman), Lara Dutta (Queen Kaikeyi), Arun Govil (King Dasharath), Kajal Aggarwal (Mandodari), Rakul Preet Singh (Shurpanakha), Vivek Oberoi (Vidyutjihva), Kunal Kapoor (Lord Indra), Raghav Juyal (Meghanad), Sheeba Chaddha (Manthara), Indira Krishnan (Kaushalya), while Anupam Kher lends his voice to Jatayu.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Varun Dhawan to headline YRF’s first-ever horror film
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Bollywood Hungama has exclusively learned that Varun Dhawan has been roped in to headline the ambitious project, marking another significant collaboration between the star and the prestigious banner.

Adding to this, Confirming the development, a source close to the project told Bollywood Hungama , “Varun has come on board as the lead for YRF’s first horror movie. Yash Raj Films (YRF) is entering the horror genre for the first time with a feature movie directed by Abhay Pannu, strategically championed by Akshaye Widhani, and now headlined by Varun Dhawan as the lead. YRF have made films across almost every genre except horror. Come 2027, and the banner will finally step into this genre.”

Meanwhile, The project will also mark Abhay Pannu’s theatrical directorial debut after receiving widespread acclaim for Rocket Boys . His association with YRF further underlines the production house’s continued focus on nurturing fresh and distinctive filmmaking talent. Under the leadership of Aditya Chopra, the studio has increasingly backed filmmakers with unique creative voices, including Mohit Suri, Sameer Saxena, and now Abhay Pannu. This approach has gained momentum following the remarkable success of Saiyaara , reaffirming YRF’s commitment to diverse storytelling and innovative cinematic ventures.

Notably, For Varun Dhawan, the soon-to-release movie will mark his second collaboration with Yash Raj Films after the success of Sui Dhaaga . With the star now set to front YRF’s maiden horror venture, anticipation surrounding the project is expected to grow as the studio prepares to expand its genre portfolio with a theatrical rollout planned for 2027.

title: Exclusive| Ranvir Shorey reacts to intense social media trolling: Have never misbehaved unless someone did it first
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Beginning Wednesday, the barrage of negativity surrounding star Ranvir Shorey refuses to slow down. It all started with a light-hearted reel featuring him dancing with his Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 co-stars Anupam Kher , Boman Irani and Parveen Dabas. It unexpectedly went widely shared, crossing a 100 million views on Instagram.

Adding to this, Ranvir Shorey An X user reposted it, and added a caption throwing shade at him. The star hit back with a crude remark, one which attracted the ire of social media immediately. Users accused him of misogyny because the profile carried a woman’s display picture.

Meanwhile, “There is no such reply on my timeline. I reply to trolls in the language they speak in, and I will not be apologetic about it. The user you are mentioning is a known toxic and abusive account, whose real gender and age are unknown to me. The kind of language that account uses is more important than if the profile picture is of a girl or boy. If girls can be gutter mouthed, then they should be ready to hear the same kind of replies too,” he tells us when we reach out to him.

Notably, The episode spiralled beyond the original exchange, with social media users digging up personal aspects of Shorey’s life and levelling allegations against him. Some went to the extent of saying his marriage with star Konkona Sen Sharma didn’t work out because of his behaviour.
As per the latest buzz, Another user alleged that they had spotted Ranvir being rude to a movie theatre staff member over a popcorn bucket.

In further updates, Dismissing them as “simply haters”, Shorey insists he has never initiated such behaviour, “Those are simply haters. This entire incident was triggered by the hate towards just a funny 15 second reel that I made with the KKG team that went hugely widely shared! I have never misbehaved with anyone unless they have misbehaved with me first. And I am under no moral, ethical or legal obligation to take any abuse or hate lying down. From men or women. I am done with this episode. I would rather think about the next reel.”

On top of that, Rishabh Suri writes for the daily Entertainment & Lifestyle supplement HT City. From Bollywood to Hollywood, from Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam films, to OTT and television- he covers it all.

title: After Randeep Hooda, Bhumi Pednekar joins Assam flood relief efforts, walks through knee-deep water to provide aid
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bhumi Pednekar of late grabbed headlines after facing backlash for criticising protesters at the CJP -led protest in Delhi over their use of foul language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Unfazed by the criticism, the star has continued to go about her life and was of late spotted participating in relief work for flood-affected communities in Assam.

Adding to this, Bhumi Pednekar joins relief effort in Assam. Bhumi joins relief efforts in Assam The star shared videos of herself participating in relief work in Assam. Bhumi travelled to the flood-hit state with the Bharat Disaster Relief Foundation (BDRF). She reposted a clip that shows her walking through knee-deep water as she reached a hut to provide aid to those affected by the floods. The caption of the clip read, "When compassion meets action, hope reaches farther. Thank you Bhumi for standing with the people of Assam."

Meanwhile, Bhumi also shared a photo of herself with flood-affected villagers and wrote, "Every flooded village reminds us that recovery doesn't begin when the rain stops, but when the help arrives." In another video, Bhumi is seen arriving at a house surrounded by water in a boat. She also highlighted the harsh reality in Assam, mentioning that "though water has receded in some areas, many villages remain accessible only by boat."

Notably, The next video shows her distributing relief material to villagers. Another clip also captures Bhumi interacting with the villagers and sharing light-hearted moments with them, bringing smiles to their faces amid the devastation.

As per the latest buzz, In an earlier video, Bhumi had criticised protesters for using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Her remarks prompted many on social media to question why she chose to school the protesters while remaining largely silent on the student-led CJP protest in Delhi demanding education reforms following the NEET paper leak row.

In further updates, Bhumi had shared in the clip, "Looking at the videos surfacing now, the kind of language being used, and the way the youth of our country are speaking — the youth of our country... this isn't how we talk, man. We are talking about someone who holds the highest office in the land today. And it’s not just about the office; would we ever speak like this to the elders in our own homes? Can we really resort to using abusive language? Guys, this isn't our culture; it’s wrong, and this really bothered me — that’s why I wanted to come forward and address this."

On top of that, Before Bhumi, Bollyood star Randeep Hooda joined on-the-ground relief efforts in Assam's Sivasagar district, actively working alongside the NGO Global Sikhs to serve hot meals (langar), pack survival kits, and distribute essential supplies to families displaced by the floods.

Bhumi was last seen in Prime Video's web series Daldal, which received mixed responses from both audiences and critics. Her last theatrical rollout was Mere Husband Ki Biwi, co-starring Arjun Kapoor and Rakul Preet Singh. The movie had an underwhelming run at the ticket-window and also received mixed reviews from critics and audiences.

title: Ameesha Patel says she's happy being single at 51, reveals why she will never marry
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Several Bollywood actors have chosen to remain single, either by choice or because they have yet to find the right partner. Actors such as Salman Khan , Sushmita Sen and Tabu have openly spoken about their single status and their decision to live life on their own terms. Now, Ameesha Patel has also opened up about why she remains unmarried at 51.

Adding to this, Ameesha Patel reveals her marriage plans at 51. Ameesha Patel says she will never get married Ameesha of late conducted an AMA session on X (formerly Twitter). During the session, a fan asked her, "When are you getting married?" Ameesha had a savage response, saying, "Never, superrr happy being single. I have 100 close family and friends who love me. Can't afford one man to come and change all that."

Meanwhile, Several followers agreed with Ameesha's views on marriage. One comment read, "That’s really great. Getting married is a compromise which hinders your ability to grow as a dream-achieving person. Being single has something more exhilarating feelings than being married." Another commented, "True, being single is the way." A third fan wrote, "Oh meet too."

Notably, Last year, Ameesha revealed during a podcast with Ranveer Allahbadia that she had been in a serious relationship, but her partner did not support her when she decided to enter the movie industry. She shared that while she has not completely ruled out marriage, she is looking for a partner who would allow her career to flourish. She added, "I am all up for marriage, as long as I find someone worthy. They say that ‘Where there is a will, there is a way,’ so the person who finds me through everything and mauke par chauka maarlege (takes advantage of the situation) will be my person. I still get all kinds of proposals from a lot of well-to-do families. People half my age want to take me out on a date, and I am open to it because a man has to be mentally mature. I have met a lot of people older than me who have the IQ of a fly.”

As per the latest buzz, Ameesha was last seen in the 2024 movie Tauba Tera Jalwa. Directed by Akashaditya Lama, the romantic comedy also starred Jatin Khurana and Angela Krislinzki in lead roles. Her last successful movie was Gadar 2, in which she starred alongside Sunny Deol. The movie was a major box-office success, collecting ₹ 686 crore rupees worldwide. Ameesha reprised her role as Sakina in the movie, directed by Anil Sharma. It also featured Utkarsh Sharma, Simrat Kaur, Manish Wadhwa and Gaurav Chopra in key roles. The star is yet to announce her next project.

title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas to star opposite Academy Award winner Russell Crowe in sci-fi action thriller Bluefly
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The announcement follows another significant career update for Priyanka, who was of late verified to star opposite Orlando Bloom in the survival thriller Reset . Earlier this year, she headlined Prime Video's The Bluff , which debuted at the top spot globally. She also featured alongside Idris Elba and John Cena in the action-comedy Heads of State , which became Prime Video's fourth most-watched movie. The movie has since received a nomination for Outstanding Television Movie at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards. Priyanka also collected a nomination for Best Star in an Action Movie at the 2026 Critics Choice Super Awards for her performance as Ercell Bodden in The Bluff . She will next appear in S.S. Rajamouli's action-adventure movie Varanasi , scheduled to rollout on April 7, 2027.

Adding to this, Bluefly is being produced by Michael Jefferson for Polite Society, David Frigerio for Broken Open Pictures, Deborah Glover for G2 Dispatch, Arianne Fraser and Delphine Perrier for Highland Movie Group, along with Vanessa Yao Guo. Executive producers include Lia Buman, Guy Davies, RuthAnne Frigerio, Brian Kavanaugh-Jones, Jason Kringstein, Katie Leary, and Scott Levenson.

Meanwhile, Highland Movie Group will oversee worldwide rights for the project and will launch international sales at the Toronto International Movie Festival (TIFF). Filming is expected to begin later this year on Australia's Gold Coast.

Notably, The story is set in the Congo and follows a grieving United Nations translator who becomes involved in a covert mission to retrieve a mysterious aircraft that officially does not exist. Accompanied by a Special Operations team travelling through militia-controlled territory, the mission gradually turns into a dangerous journey where the truth behind the aircraft reveals that it was never meant to be recovered.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about the project, Highland Movie Group CEO Arianne Fraser shared, "We have a stellar cast led by Russell Crowe and Priyanka Chopra Jonas who will ignite the screen in this high-stakes, sci-fi thrill ride with layers of depth, akin to Denis Villeneuve's Arrival ." She further added, " Bluefly is heart-pounding entertainment with a complex story full of unexpected twists. With Nimród Antal at the helm and our wonderful cast, we cannot wait to introduce this fantastic project to our global buyers."

In further updates, Director Nimród Antal also shared his excitement about the movie, saying, " Bluefly is an intense, character-driven thriller wrapped inside a bold science-fiction premise. It's the kind of movie I live to make — grounded, propulsive, and full of dread — and I couldn't ask for a better cast or team to bring it to the screen."

On top of that, Russell Crowe, an Academy Award winner for Gladiator , continues to expand his filmography with projects including Unabomber , The Weight , Billion Dollar Spy , and Amazon MGM's Highlander . Meanwhile, Priyanka Chopra Jonas remains one of the most prominent Indian actors on the global stage, balancing acting, production, and international projects, with Bluefly marking yet another significant addition to her Hollywood journey.

title: Aditya Dhar's 'peak detailing’ in Dhurandhar cost ₹10 crore extra, reveals R Madhavan
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Filmmaker Aditya Dhar 's Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge created a stir at the ticket-window, but one of the biggest talking points around the films was their “peak detailing”. The phrase soon became a meme across social media, with audiences celebrating the filmmaker's meticulous attention to detail. In a recent interview with Glute.com, R Madhavan, who played a pivotal role in the films, opened up that Aditya spent an additional ₹ 10 crore rupees on the detailing.

Adding to this, R Madhavan reveals secret behind Aditya Dhar's peak detailing. R Madhavan reveals how much Aditya Dhar spent on peak detailing Madhavan shared, "Can you imagine a project that is so lengthy, like eight hours, in which you have to invest time to add details you have in your mind, but which might be missed? Now, if somebody was told before the movie that they spent ₹ 10 crore rupees extra only towards this peak detailing, they’d say, ‘You’re mad. Who sees all that? Nobody sees. It won’t be seen.’ I would have shared it."

Meanwhile, The star added that the success of Dhurandhar “shook him up” and shared, "For me, it shook me up because… no, actually I won’t say it shook me up. I think it reiterated what I’ve been believing for the longest time. I needed an endorsement that I’m going in the right direction. It reaffirmed my faith that our storytellers have to catch up with our audience. I think that’s the biggest revelation."

Notably, “Peak Detailing by Aditya Dhar” became a widely shared phrase and was widely used in memes celebrating the filmmaker's attention to detail. Aditya also joined in on the trend, acknowledging the memes in a birthday post on X and thanking audiences for their love and support. He also shared that he thoroughly enjoyed watching the memes make the rounds online.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Aditya Dhar, the two-part movie franchise features Ranveer Singh in the lead role, alongside Sara Arjun, R Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt and Rakesh Bedi in key roles. The films went on to become major box-office successes.

In further updates, The first part collected around ₹ 1,300 crore rupees worldwide, while Dhurandhar: The Revenge surpassed it with a worldwide collection of over ₹ 1,800 crore rupees. The second part also became the first Bollywood movie to cross the ₹ 1,000-crore rupees mark at the Indian ticket-window.

The Tamil-language movie, directed by Krishnakumar Ramakumar, stars Madhavan in the titular role alongside Sathyaraj, Jayaram, Priyamani and Dushara Vijayan. The movie is based on the life of inventor and engineer G D Naidu.

In the new season of Conan O'Brien Must Go, the show is going to serve up a taste of India to its global audience. Indian actors Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal will grace the screen for the India centric episode of the Emmy Award-winning comedy-travel show. With the rollout of the new Season 3 trailer, their appearance is giving an indication of their funny exchange with the celebrated comedian Conan O'Brien.

Adding to this, Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal join Conan O'Brien for hilarious India adventure in Must Go Season 3. Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal feature in Conan O'Brien Must Go Season 3 Conan O’Brien will meet with Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal during his tour of India for a funny and informal chat session. Judging from the trailer, the interaction is quite funny and showcases Conan’s self-deprecating humour and the fun-loving nature of the couple. Ali is seen saying, “You let the white person in and it's a full takeover.” To which, Conan cheekily responds, “I am not just a white person. He is also seen meeting followers he first connected with through his podcast, Conan O'Brien Needs a Fan. title: Ohh My Dog review: This Pankaj Tripathi starrer about fur babies is family friendly, yet too predictable to leave a mark
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Dogs, a heartwarming tale of a furry companion rescuing its human, and a pet parent desperately searching for his lost pup. On paper, Ohh My Dog had already won me over before the opening scene had even played. What unfolded over the next two and a half hours, however, was a different story.

Adding to this, Ohh My Dog tells the story of two separated pups, Momo and Oscar, as their humans search for them. I once heard someone in the business say that filmmakers should never work with babies or animals. One, because they're delightfully unpredictable. Two, because, well... they easily steal the scene from adult actors. Watching Ohh My Dog, I couldn't help but wonder if that old piece of wisdom deserved another mention.

Meanwhile, The story revolves around Momo and Oscar, two pups separated soon after birth. While Momo finds a loving home in a family in Assam, Oscar is adopted by Prince, a labourer working at a construction site. One day, both Momo and Prince mysteriously go missing. What follows forms the crux of the movie.

Notably, Director Amit Rai cheekily flips the title of his previous movie, Oh My God 2 and it's a clever touch. What works in Ohh My Dog's favour is how refreshingly clean it is. There's hardly a scene that feels unsuitable for a family audience, with Rai ensuring the storytelling remains accessible and engaging, especially for children.

As per the latest buzz, The first half is neatly structured around two parallel investigations into the disappearances. Where the movie begins to lose its footing, however, is in the execution. In its attempt to keep the storytelling simple, the screenplay slips into predictability and stretches believability a little too far. An entire police force being terrified of a dog may make for an amusing gag once, but the joke wears thin with repetition. Much of the runtime is spent reiterating just how intelligent these four-legged companions are. While the message is endearing, the storytelling isn't compelling enough to keep you invested. The movie repeatedly asks you to suspend your disbelief, but it stretches that elastic a little too far. The same goes for the child prodigy, who somehow manages to outsmart an entire police force with surprising ease. While these moments are designed to be crowd-pleasing, they end up feeling more convenient than convincing.
In further updates, The pacing doesn't help either. There are stretches where the narrative slows, causing the momentum built by the central mystery to fizzle out instead of gathering steam.

On top of that, The performances are uniformly sincere. Mohit Raai delivers a confident turn as the whiz kid determined to find his beloved Momo, while the canine cast effortlessly steals hearts. Pankaj Tripathi makes a special appearance, but the role doesn't give him much to sink his teeth into. Geeta Aggarwal emerges as the standout performer, bringing warmth to every scene she's in. Pawan Malhotra shouts most of his dialogues.

Overall, Amit Rai clearly sets out to make a wholesome movie with Ohh My Dog that celebrates the unique bond between humans and their pets, and there is genuine warmth in that vision. The movie never resorts to cheap humour that feels out of place for a family audience, which is refreshing in itself. Yet, every time the narrative has an opportunity to surprise, it settles for the obvious. The mystery is solved through convenient writing rather than clever plotting. Emotional moments are stretched longer than they need to be, and several sequences rely on exaggerated situations. By the time the end credits roll, the dogs leave a far stronger impression than the story.

It led to the rollout of various fan-favorite content, still available today of course, such as our challenging Ghost Mode, or multiple Clancy-verse missions featuring Splinter Cell or Rainbow Six Siege.

In further updates, There was one key element that really stuck to me to this day – a group we initially called “Sandbox Players.” To be honest, at first, we did not really understand what the heck they were doing in our Bolivian Wildlands. Digging more, and more, notably thanks to community interviews and data-informed playtests, it finally clicked: they were role playing, ranging from cooperative mil-sim to simply adding extra optional layers of challenges on top of the game just for fun, taking hours to complete one mission perfectly. We had tons of players leveraging everything the game had to offer to transcend their gameplay experience to the next level.

On top of that, The level of customization and the overall freedom of choice the game offers were lauded all around and for us that’s one of the main reasons players are still engaging with Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Wildlands today. title: Raveena Tandon almost got bitten by the Ohh My Dog star; actor's reaction wins hearts online. Watch video
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Raveena Tandon of late attended the special screening of Pankaj Tripathi ’s movie Ohh My Dog , but the red carpet came with an unexpected scare. The star was almost bitten by the movie’s four-legged star, but instead of panicking, Raveena handled the moment with remarkable calm. Her composed reaction has now won praise from the internet.

Adding to this, Raveena Tandon almost got bit by a dog at Ohh My Dog screening. Raveena Tandon almost got bitten by a dog On Thursday, a special screening of Ohh My Dog was held in Mumbai. Raveena attended the event and posed with the movie’s canine star. However, things took an unexpected turn when the dog began barking aggressively and almost bit her as she stood up after posing for pictures. A thread from her dress became stuck in the dog’s mouth. Raveena remained calm throughout the incident and stepped forward to soothe the animal instead of backing away.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Widely shared Bhayani (@viralbhayani)

Notably, Her reaction impressed followers, with one commenting, “Thank you for your patience and kindness Raveena ma'am.” Another wrote, “Sign of a true animal lover.” A fan shared, “The dog must be stressed with a lot happening around. Thanks to Raveena for handling it with poise.” Another commented, “Man, she is so calm and composed. Huge respect for her.”

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Amit Rai, Ohh My Dog is a family entertainer featuring a dog at the centre of its story. The movie follows a courageous dog who helps uncover a racket involving missing dogs. Apart from Pankaj Tripathi, the movie also stars Pavan Malhotra, Maahi Rai, Rajesh Kumar, Geeta Agrawal, Vijay Mishra, Shreedhar Dubey, Bulloo Kumar and Sulakhyana Baruah.
In further updates, The trailer shows a growing number of dogs going missing from an area, leading to suspicions of a larger racket. It also features sequences of dogs chasing goons.

On top of that, Director Amit Rai has described the movie as a story aimed at families while also highlighting kindness towards animals. “Dogs teach us the purest form of love and loyalty without expecting anything in return. Through Ohh My Dog, I wanted to tell a story that is emotional, entertaining, and meaningful for every family. This is not just a movie about a child and a dog; it is about learning to coexist with all living beings with compassion. If audiences walk away with a little more kindness in their hearts towards animals, I will feel this movie has truly achieved its purpose,” he shared.

Backed by Amit Rai, Rajesh Bhardwaj and Sana Warsi under the banners of Babulal Biscope and Thinking Hats Entertainment, Ohh My Dog rolled out in theatres on August 7. The movie’s rollout was postponed by a week from July 31 to August 7 amid competition for screens from other major releases.

title: ‘Dhurandhar was the most-watched non-English movie in the world this year’: Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

Dhurandhar , starring Ranveer Singh , has yet again achieved something remarkable. Not long after making history at the ticket-window, the Aditya Dhar directorial has got international acclaim from Ted Sarandos, Co-CEO of Netflix, who shared that the movie is the most-watched non-English movie this year. Talking about the increasing trend of Indian content around the globe, Ted shared that India has already arrived and Dhurandhar is setting an example.

Adding to this, Ted Sarandos reveals Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar was Netflix's biggest non-English movie worldwide this year. What Ted Sarandos shared Speaking at Express Adda, Ted Sarandos shared how strongly the movie performed on the platform. “Dhurandhar was the most-watched non-English movie in the world this year. Bigger than every other English [movie] and second only to the US and the UK in terms of watching,” he shared.

Meanwhile, The first movie garnered 37 million views from January to June 2026. It also was number one on the Netflix list of 22 countries. Directed by Aditya Dhar, the Dhurandhar franchise collected more than ₹ 3,100 crore rupees in worldwide collection through two movies. The second installment, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, became the first Bollywood movie ever to surpass ₹ 1,000 crore rupees mark in net in India.
Notably, Ted Sarandos also answered a question raised whenever one talks about Indian entertainment on the international stage—that is, when would India get its very own Squid Game or Money Heist?

As per the latest buzz, His answer was simple. “I hear a lot when I travel around the world, particularly in India, is like what happened with Squid Game, what happened with La casa de papel, when is India going to have that moment? And I say India has that moment all the time. It’s much more likely to be in cinema. I think, right now, because there is this enormous, beautiful, rich, long history of movies in India. I think when we came in and made Sacred Games, it was a whole different kind of television, so through most of the history and all that that’s coming through, it’s likely to come through in the form of cinema,” he added.

In further updates, Ted brought to light the increasing international demand for Indian movies and TV series on the streaming service, stating that Indian content has been among the top-rated globally on the platform. He shared that there has been an Indian movie or TV series in the top 10 globally for each week since 2024. He ttributed this success to Netflix's recommendation algorithm, which helps viewers discover content they will enjoy. He therefore opened up that 3.5 billion hours of Indian content have been watched this year by the audience globally.

On top of that, The first Dhurandhar rolled out in theatres in December 2025 before making its Netflix debut shortly ahead of the sequel's theatrical rollout in March 2026. Dhurandhar: The Revenge is now streaming in India on both Netflix and JioHotstar.

title: Soha Ali Khan, Saba Pataudi reveal why they didn't attend Saif Ali Khan's wedding with Amrita Singh: ‘We were told…’
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Saif Ali Khan’s first marriage to Amrita Singh has often been discussed, but a lesser-known detail about their 1991 wedding has now come to light. Saif’s sisters, Saba Pataudi and Soha Ali Khan , were so young at the time that they did not attend the wedding. Speaking on Neha Dhupia and Angad Bedi’s show Double Date, Soha and Saba recalled how they learnt about their brother’s marriage while they were still in school.

Adding to this, Soha Ali Khan and Saba Pataudi missed out on Saif Ali Khan and Amrita Singh's wedding. Why Soha Ali Khan and Saba Pataudi didn't attend Saif Ali Khan's first wedding Saba opened up that she was 15 and Soha was 13 at the time and shared, “He got married when we were in school. We got a call in the principal’s office from the parents saying you won’t tell anyone anything. We don’t know how real the news is because it was in the newspapers by then. So we were told that we shouldn’t.”

Meanwhile, Neha Dhupia was surprised to learn that Saif’s sisters had not attended the wedding. Soha explained, “Also, we were very young then. I remember my French teacher told me. It was a last-minute affair.”

Notably, Saif and Amrita's marriage was one of Bollywood’s much-talked-about relationships in the 1990s. The two as per reports met when Saif was making his acting debut, while Amrita was already an established star in the industry. Despite their 12-year age gap and differences in their family backgrounds, they decided to marry in 1991. Their wedding as per reports came as a surprise to their families, with Saif being just 21 at the time.

As per the latest buzz, The couple welcomed their daughter, Sara Ali Khan, in 1995 and son Ibrahim Ali Khan in 2001. After 13 years of marriage, Saif and Amrita separated in 2004. Sara has previously spoken about her parents being unhappy together and shared their separation was ultimately the best decision for everyone.

In further updates, Following the divorce, Amrita largely focused on raising their children, while Saif went on to marry Kareena Kapoor in 2012. He has maintained a close bond with Sara and Ibrahim, who have both followed their parents into the movie industry. Saif and Kareena have two sons, Taimur Ali Khan and Jehangir Ali Khan.

On top of that, Sara made her Bollywood debut with Kedarnath in 2018 and has since appeared in films including Simmba and Zara Hatke Zara Bachke. Ibrahim made his acting debut with the OTT movie Nadaaniyan and later appeared in Sarzameen.

title: Pankaj Tripathi says Indian films are global now as they go more local: 'Pehle writers Mumbai se Bharat ko samajhte the'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The last few years have seen Indian films travel across borders to be feted at various movie festivals and award shows around the world, and in some cases, even break the bank at foreign box offices beyond the diaspora. Be it mainstream offerings like RRR or Kill, or independent films like All We Imagine as Light or Songs of Forgotten Trees, Indian films are winning hearts worldwide. Star Pankaj Tripathi , who has seen his fair share of cinema over the years, believes this shift is because of Indian writers and filmmakers returning to their roots.

Adding to this, Pankaj Tripathi reflects on Indian cinema's increasing global appeal. In a candid chat with Hindustan Times, the star reflects on how Indian cinema is going back to its core strength of focusing on what is local and cultural, something that Western audiences want to see.

Meanwhile, “The core value of Indian emotion is empathy,” says the two-time National Award winner. “And then, our culture has so many festivals, across states and regions. So, when one incorporates that in stories, our culture, our emotions in an authentic manner, then that becomes global. That is the strength of Indian stories.”

Notably, Pankaj talks about the time when Indian films became too multiplex-oriented and catered largely for urban audiences, as the time when Indian cinema lost that global appeal. “There was a time when our stories became a little too urban. Jab waise writer the jo Mumbai mein baith ke Bharat ko samajhte the (we had writers who understood India sitting in Mumbai),” he adds.

As per the latest buzz, But he attributes the change seen today to filmmakers who came to Mumbai from smaller towns, bringing their worldviews and understanding with them. “Now, time has changed. Bhilai se Anurag Basu aa gaye, Jamshedpur se Imtiaz Ali aa gaye aur Allahabad se Tigmanshu Dhulia aa gaye. These people have come after understanding literature and culture and after seeing the world,” he adds.

In further updates, Pankaj is appearing in an experimental movie, Ohh My Dog, releasing this week. The movie features a dog as the protagonist, with Pankaj and other veteran actors appearing in supporting roles. Talking about the movie, he says, “There are people who don’t like dogs or animals. The issue is that they fear them. But once you get to understand the animal, the fear will leave your body. So, I hope that when people watch this movie, they develop some empathy for pets and animals. These creatures have been living with us for thousands of years. Just understand them, and 99% of the problems will end.”

On top of that, Directed by Amit Rai, Ohh My Dog releases in theatres on August 7. Pankaj Tripathi will then reprise his role as Akhandanand Tripathi in Mirzapur , the movie, a prequel spinoff to the successful Prime Video series. The movie releases in theatres in September.

title: The next chapter of our AI momentum
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
Chair, Google DeepMind and Chief Scientist, Alphabet

Adding to this, Editor’s note: Today, Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai shared some changes with Google DeepMind teams, including new roles for Demis Hassabis and Koray Kavukcuoglu. Below are the messages Sundar and Demis sent to employees.

Meanwhile, We’ve made extraordinary progress to deliver on our full AI stack. We’ve got amazing talent, world-class compute, and products that bring AI to more people than any other company. And you saw the incredible momentum at earnings across all our businesses, including Search, YouTube, and Cloud. Our Gemini models are in high demand among developers and businesses, and the Gemini app reached 950M+ monthly users. Meanwhile, our AI research continues to drive field-defining breakthroughs (like last week’s Gemini Robotics advances).

Notably, We have to accelerate all this work and stay focused on the AI frontier. At the same time, there’s never been a more important moment to shape the future of AGI and science. Today Demis, Koray and I are sharing a few changes to our Google DeepMind teams that will enable us to do both.

As per the latest buzz, AGI and science: Demis has described us as standing in the foothills of the singularity, and has been spending a lot of his time engaging externally . He and I have been long discussing a role that allows him to put his full attention on actively shaping the future of AGI. It’s work that is vitally important to Alphabet and humanity, and I can’t imagine a better person than Demis to do it. So, moving forward, Demis will become the Chair of GDM and Chief Scientist of Alphabet, while continuing to lead Isomorphic Labs . He’ll remain closely connected to Koray, Josh, and our GDM teams, advising across models and research. I’m so excited for Demis — this is truly his life’s work and purpose. You can read Demis’s note to GDM below.

In further updates, Google DeepMind: We are building strong momentum: Flash is in high demand, our Cyber model is live, and Gemma models have surpassed 900M+ downloads. We are committed to being at the frontier, and are super focused on the areas where we need to improve. I’m really excited for our soon-to-release model releases and the progress we’re seeing. We have to continue to move fast and with clear purpose here. Koray , the current Chief Technology Officer of GDM and our Chief AI Architect, will step up as SVP of Google DeepMind, reporting to me. He will oversee Gemini model development, Frontier AI research, and the Gemini app and developer teams. Koray has been at DeepMind since its early days, and over his 13 years there, he has started our deep learning team and led the way on breakthroughs like WaveNet and DQN. I look forward to seeing him lead GDM into this next chapter.

On top of that, Lastly, after an incredible 27-year run, Jeff Dean is at a moment where he wants to try something new, and we’re excited to support him in that. Jeff and Google Senior Fellow Sanjay Ghemawat are launching an independent public benefit corporation to accelerate discoveries in ML, science, and engineering. Jeff and Sanjay helped to drive some of the most significant technology transitions, from our early search infrastructure to the neural networks that helped create the modern AI era. On a personal note, it’s been a privilege to work alongside Jeff and Sanjay, and I wish them all the best! We’ll continue to work with them as a founding investor and Cloud partner, and collaborate on a research framework for ML systems and related infrastructure advances.

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Search Search Delhi Login Find a car Cars Compare cars New cars Soon-to-release cars Car loan calculator Find a bike Bikes Compare bikes New New bikes New scooters Soon-to-release Soon-to-release bikes Soon-to-release scooters Electric Electric bikes Electric scooters Bike loan calculator News Cars Bikes Motorsports Industry Marketplace Reviews Car First drive / reviews Comparisons Video reviews Long-term reviews Bike First ride / reviews Comparisons Video reviews Long-term reviews Features Features Travelogues Blogs Interviews Partner content Galleries Videos Images Sell your car Stories Get advice Bike News Follow us E3 Trion electric scooter launched at Rs 1 lakh Bengaluru-based EV startup E3 Electric.AI enters the market with three variants of its first electric scooter. 2 min read • 6 Aug '26 Ved Janve

Adding to this, Bengaluru-based electric mobility startup E3 Electric.AI has launched its first electric scooter, the Trion, at an introductory price of Rs 1 lakh (ex-showroom, Bengaluru). The new electric scooter is available in three variants – C1, C1x and C2 – and the company is positioning AI-based predictive features and a modular platform as its key differentiators.

Meanwhile, The entry-level Trion C1 uses a removable 2.3kWh LFP battery, while the C1x and C2 get larger, fixed 3kWh LFP units. All three variants use a PMSM hub motor, although E3 has yet to disclose detailed motor output figures.

Notably, E3 claims an IDC range of 165km for the C1x. The range figure for the C1 hasn’t been revealed yet. Meanwhile, the range-topping C2 has a claimed top speed of 82kph and can accelerate from 0-40kph in 6 seconds. The C1 and C1x have Eco and Power riding modes, while the C2 adds a Sport mode.

As per the latest buzz, The Trion rides on 14-inch wheels, which are larger than those on most electric scooters currently on sale in India. E3 also says the scooter offers up to 52 litres of combined storage across its underseat compartment, floorboard and glovebox. However, just the underseat storage capacity figure hasn’t been disclosed.

In further updates, E3 describes the Trion as India’s first AI-powered intelligent electric scooter. Central to this is what the company calls the E3 CommandCenter, which uses vehicle and cloud data to monitor the scooter and provide predictive diagnostics and service alerts.

On top of that, The scooter gets a 5-inch LCD display and connected functionality through the company’s TripSense system, which essentially uses the Rider's smartphone as a secondary display to provide additional information. Features include navigation, a trip planner with charger locations, remote battery monitoring, vehicle controls, geofencing, SOS assistance and a dashcam. E3 also claims that its AI HealthScan feature can perform vehicle diagnostics in 10 seconds.

The battery system incorporates what E3 calls an AI Digital Twin, which is claimed to provide real-time diagnostics and predictive information about the battery. Both battery options use LFP chemistry.

title: 'Operation Safed Sagar contributed over Rs 215 crores to Indian economy,' says Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:
The announcement highlights what Netflix describes as "The Netflix Effect," referring to the wider economic and industry impact generated by its original productions beyond entertainment.

Adding to this, Speaking at the premiere, Sarandos lauded India's growing filmmaking ecosystem and the scale at which the series was mounted. "Every Netflix production is also a local production. Behind every episode are thousands of people whose creativity, skill and dedication make that story possible. The scale of this series and the production demonstrates that India today has the talent, the technical expertise and the production capabilities to create entertainment that stands confidently alongside the very best in the world," he shared.

Meanwhile, He added, "After ten years in India, we've seen The Netflix Effect come to life through every story we've had the privilege of making here. Tonight, Operation Safed Sagar is one of the most powerful expressions of that journey."

Notably, Filmed over 115 days across 11 Indian cities, including Patiala, Chandigarh, Gwalior, Bikaner, Mumbai, Noida, Gurugram, New Delhi, Manali, Keylang and Pataudi, the production also shot at operational Indian Air Force bases in Nal, Chandigarh and Gwalior, as well as high-altitude locations in Himachal Pradesh reaching nearly 16,000 feet.

As per the latest buzz, According to Netflix, the series directly hired more than 200 cast and crew members from eight states while creating opportunities for over 4,000 daily hires during production.

In further updates, The project also partnered with over 850 local businesses across construction, set design, hospitality, transport, logistics, catering, equipment rental, technical services and post-production, contributing to local economies in every filming location.

On top of that, A significant portion of the project's investment went into visual effects and creative technology. Netflix collaborated with 15 India-based VFX studios across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad and Chennai, engaging nearly 1,200 artists to create approximately 50 minutes of aerial sequences for the series.
These VFX partnerships alone contributed around US$5 million (over Rs 49 crore rupees) to India's economy, accounting for nearly 20 percent of the production's total economic contribution.

title: Pakistani viewers left speechless by Ramayana trailer, defend its ₹4000 crore budget: ‘Tumhare paise leke bana rahe?’
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana is one of the most anticipated films of the year. The much-awaited trailer of the movie was finally rolled out on July 30, and social media was abuzz with reactions from viewers. The trailer has now found viewers in Pakistan too, as YouTubers from the country shared their reactions to the Ramayana trailer.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor in a still from the Nitesh Tiwari movie. What are Pakistani YouTubers saying? Pakistani YouTuber MZee Reactions shared their reaction to the trailer. As they played the trailer, they went ‘wow’ at several points, from Ravana's fight to Ranbir Kapoor 's entry as Lord Rama to the big fight with Jatayu at the end of the video. After the trailer ended, the three of them started discussing what they liked about it.

Meanwhile, They noted how detailed the trailer looked. Regarding the story, they shared that they became familiar with the story when they had seen Adipurush but here it seems much more detailed. ‘Sone ki lanka’ was one point which caught their attention. The scene where Ravana walks and sees thousands of people below was also lauded. The contrast between the aggressive nature of Ravana and the calm, composed stature of Lord Rama also caught their attention.

Notably, The Pakistani YouTubers called the trailer ‘zabardast (amazing)’ and shared that the details left them speechless. They noted that the first Rama glimpse was not that great and was met with criticism but this time the makers seem to have made a ‘marked difference’ and improved the VFX. Defending the estimated ₹ 4000 crore rupees budget of the movie, the woman at the centre of the video shared, “Mujhe ye cheez bhi badi ajeeb lagti hai ki kaun sa tumhare jeb se paise leke bana rahe hai? Ye toh ek industry he aur unka kaam hai moviemaking. Investors hote hai (I don't understand the criticism, did they make the movie after taking money from your pocket? This is their job as filmmakers, and there are investors).”

As per the latest buzz, The trailer opens with Ravana (Yash) arriving at a palace and knocking on its massive doors, only to receive a hostile welcome. It then introduces Ranbir Kapoor as Prince Ram, who is seen fighting demons to protect his land and people, with the help of his brother Lakshman (Ravi Dubey).

In further updates, The trailer then shows Ram being sent into 14 years of vanvaas after a promise made to Kaikeyi (Lara Dutta). His wife, Sita ( Sai Pallavi ), expresses her wish to accompany him. The trailer also offers glimpses of the larger conflict between Ram and Ravana, with several large-scale action sequences and elaborate VFX. Interestingly, there is no mention or visual of Lord Hanuman in the trailer.

On top of that, Speaking on The Prakhar Gupta Xperience podcast, producer Namit Malhotra had shared, "When we set out to make it, 6-7 years ago, when we really got serious about mounting it, everybody called me a lunatic, because no Indian movie comes close to it budgetwise. To put it simply, it will be about $500 million by the time we are done with both the films - Part 1 and Part 2, which is over ₹ 4000 crore rupees."

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is intended to be a two-part movie with Part 1 releasing on Diwali 2026 and Part 2 in 2027. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Yash as Ravana, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Hanuman. The score for the movie sees AR Rahman collaborate with the legendary Hans Zimmer, who is making his Bollywood debut.

title: ‘Completely false and baseless’: Golmaal 5 makers dispel rumours about Rohit Shetty and Ajay Devgn film's release date
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Official statement from makers In a press statement, the spokesperson of Rohit Shetty Picturez shared, "We have come across speculation regarding the rollout date of our soon-to-release movie, Golmaal 5. We would like to clarify that these reports are completely false and baseless.

Meanwhile, Our entire team is currently focused on making an entertaining movie for audiences and we look forward to sharing official updates at the appropriate time. Any information regarding the movie, including its rollout date, will be communicated only through our official announcements.
Notably, We request members of the media to refrain from publishing or circulating misleading information. We appreciate your continued support and cooperation."

As per the latest buzz, Ajay Devgn , Arshad Warsi, Shreyas Talpade, Kunal Kemmu, Tusshar Kapoor and Sharman Joshi will join Golmaal 5. The new entry in the sequel will be Akshay Kumar! Akshay posted on Instagram to share the announcement video earlier this year. It begins with Ajay Devgn, Arshad Warsi, Shreyas Talpade, Kunal Kemmu and Tusshar Kapoor celebrating Sharman Joshi's return to the franchise. But the real surprise lands later-- Akshay Kumar .

In further updates, With a bald look, wearing a black kurta pyjama and dark sunglasses, Akshay looked ready for business. He gave Ajay multiple hugs as he joined the team. “Happy Birthday @itsrohitshetty 🎉 On your birthday, the madness just got bigger and louder. Excited to be joining this crazy family of Golmaal 5! Let the chaos begin,” wrote the star.

On top of that, Writer Farhad Samji of late told HT that the energy on set is infectious and confidently calls the soon-to-release movie the best the franchise has made so far. “When I write Golmaal, I have the advantage that the characters, like the mute one, are already hits,” he noted, during a conversation with Hindustan Times after the rollout of Welcome to the Jungle.

“I have an emotional connection to it; it's like a family. We writers and actors remember our life milestones—like when someone's kid started school or got married—based on which Golmaal movie we were shooting at the time. Our landmark timings depend on Golmaal,” he added.

title: Main Vaapas Aaunga OTT release: When and where to watch Imtiaz Ali's Partition drama starring Vedang Raina, Sharvari
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

Main Vaapas Aaunga OTT rollout date : Filmmaker Imtiaz Ali 's highly acclaimed romantic drama Main Vaapas Aaunga is finally set to get its OTT rollout. Missed the movie, starring Naseeruddin Shah , Vedang Raina and Sharvari, in theatres? Wait no longer as viewers can watch the movie from the comfort of their homes from tomorrow!

Adding to this, Main Vaapas Aaunga OTT rollout date: Vedang Raina and Sharvari in a still from the movie. Main Vaapas Aaunga OTT rollout date On Thursday, the official account of Netflix India revealed through an Instagram post that Main Vaapas Aaunga is all set to premiere on the platform on August 7, Friday. "78 saal pehle jo kahaani adhoori reh gayi thi, woh ab poori hogi! Watch Main Vaapas Aaunga, out 7 August, on Netflix!" read the caption.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Netflix India (@netflix_in)

Notably, Main Vaapas Aaunga is directed by Imtiaz Ali and tells the story of a 95-year-old man who suffers a stroke while desperately trying to rush to Pakistan. His grandson is able to piece together bits and pieces from a pre-partition past as the old man drifts in and out of recollection, but struggles to find peace in his final days. The movie attempts to understand the human impact long after the borders were drawn.

As per the latest buzz, Hindustan Times’ review of Main Vaapas Aaunga reads: “Overall, perhaps what lingers most about Main Vaapas Aaunga is that it isn't really a movie about Partition or even lost love. It's a movie about memory itself. About the people and emotions that refuse to leave us, even when everything else begins to fade. In an era where Hindi cinema often mistakes scale for feeling, Main Vaapas Aaunga delivers something far rarer: a deeply human story. It may stumble occasionally, but when it soars, it reaches the kind of emotional heights few filmmakers today can access."

In further updates, The movie was rolled out in theatres in June to positive reviews but had a slow start at the ticket-window. But nobody could predict the remarkable box-office turnaround of the Imtiaz Ali movie, which has surely become one of the year's most talked-about success stories. The movie managed to become a commercial hit by recovering its costs through theatrical and non-theatrical revenues, shared producer Mohit Choudhary in a statement to news agency PTI. “The ticket-window success of Main Vaapas Aaunga is a reflection of the love the movie has received from the audience. A very strong word of mouth powers it ahead as it marches towards a 50-plus day theatrical run,” he shared.

On top of that, “In its sixth week, the movie has already recovered its cost from the theatrical and non-theatrical revenue streams. This seemed extremely difficult at the start of its theatrical journey. While the movie has been and will always remain a 'people's hit', it is now officially also a commercial hit,” he added. Backed by glowing word-of-mouth, the movie witnessed a massive surge in ticket sales. Audiences fell in love with the performances, and the soundtrack quickly took over the charts, breathing new life into its theatrical run.

(ANI Photo/Rahul Singh) (Rahul Singh) What Kangana shared In conversation with news agency ANI on Thursday, Kangana accused the Congress of hypocrisy. "Our Gen Z, our children, are truly enduring various forms of hardship, a situation that has persisted for decades. The Congress party created such a spectacle here in Delhi. They even attempted to launch an attack in Parliament. Yet, now that the situation for children in Jharkhand is so dire, Rahul Gandhi is not visiting them," she shared.

Meanwhile, She added, “Lekin jab logo ko uksana hota hai, bachcho ko jo hai desh ki security pe khatra karna hota hai tab wo hai (But when it comes to inciting people or endangering the country's security, Rahul Gandhi is the first to step forward as a threat to the nation).”

Notably, The protesters, who have been staging an indefinite sit-in at Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium here since July 29, alleged that the JMM-led government was attempting to "whitewash" the issue by entrusting the investigation to the CID.

As per the latest buzz, They had earlier demanded an investigation by the CBI along with that of the Enforcement Directorate (ED), claiming large-scale financial transactions were linked to the alleged recruitment scam.

In further updates, Kangana also welcomed Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg 's apology over the temporary removal of Prime Minister Narendra Modi 's video, saying she hoped such incidents would not recur given the concerns over national security. In conversation with ANI, she shared, "We are very pleased that the errors have been acknowledged, and we hope for relief in the future regarding the growing threat posed to our national security by these terrorist forces."

On top of that, The remarks came a day after sources shared Zuckerberg had apologised to the government over issues relating to Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM), deepfake content and operational errors on the platform.

Economy Gold jumps to one-month high of Rs 1.5 lakh/10g in Delhi; silver surges Rs 6,200 PTI 05 August, 2026 05:47 pm IST Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin Follow Us : Text Size: A- A+ --> New Delhi, Aug 5 (PTI) Gold prices rallied for the second straight session to hit a one-month high of Rs 1.5 lakh per 10 grams in the national capital on Wednesday, tracking a sharp rise in global precious metal rates.

Adding to this, The yellow metal of 99.9 per cent purity appreciated by Rs 2,500, or 1.7 per cent, to Rs 1,50,000 per 10 grams (inclusive of all taxes) from Tuesday’s closing level of Rs 1,47,500 per 10 grams, according to the All India Sarafa Association.

Meanwhile, Silver also resumed its upward march after remaining flat in the previous session, surging by Rs 6,200 to almost a one-month high of Rs 2,32,700 per kilogram (inclusive of all taxes). It had settled at Rs 2,26,500 per kg in the preceding session.

Notably, “Gold prices climbed to a one-month high as growing optimism over a potential US-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz eased concerns over energy-driven inflation and reduced expectations of further monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve,” shared Saumil Gandhi, Senior Analyst – Commodities at HDFC Securities.
As per the latest buzz, In global markets, spot gold gained USD 85.28, or 2.09 per cent, to USD 4,162.76 per ounce, while silver rose a little over 3 per cent to USD 61.35 per ounce.

In further updates, “Spot gold is globally trading with a steep gain of 2 per cent at USD 4,160 per ounce as a pullback in crude oil prices has alleviated interest rate hike concerns by the Federal Reserve,” shared Praveen Singh, Head of Commodities at Mirae Asset ShareKhan.

On top of that, However, Singh noted that crude oil prices pared their losses and turned higher after Yemen’s Houthis threatened attacks on Saudi tankers in the northern Red Sea despite hopes of progress in US-Iran talks.

Jateen Trivedi, VP Research Analyst – Commodity and Currency, LKP Securities, shared market participants are awaiting the US ADP employment data, followed by the nonfarm payrolls report and the unemployment rate later this week, for fresh cues on the Fed’s interest rate trajectory.

He also addressed the audience and shared his vision for the films that will be rolled out in two parts. Namit’s new studio was inaugurated by CM Fadnavis at Movie City, Mumbai. At the WAVES Summit, Prime Focus and the Maharashtra government had revealed plans to develop what they called a Global Entertainment Ecosystem in Mumbai.

Meanwhile, The Ramayana films are directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra ’s DNEG in association with Yash’s Monster Mind Creations. DNEG, which operates under Prime Focus, is an eight-time Academy Award winner for Best Visual Effects. The outfit has worked on films such as Dune: Part Two, Dune and Tenet. The movie will star Ranbir Kapoor as Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The movie’s trailer was of late rolled out online after being showcased at the San Diego Comic-Con and a Pratham Sankalp event in New Delhi. Part 1 will hit screens for Diwali 2026, while Part 2 will rollout for Diwali 2027.

Notably, The Ramayana trailer introduced the main leads and other characters, including Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanaka and Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi. The movie received mixed reviews, with inevitable comparisons drawn with Om Raut’s Adipurush. Shri Ramlila Mahasangh wrote to the filmmakers, requesting that they screen the movie for its representatives before its theatrical rollout, claiming that certain scenes could hurt Hindu sentiments. The organisation’s president, Arjun Kumar, brought up the Prabhas, Kriti Sanon, and Saif Ali Khan-starrer as the reason they want to watch it beforehand.

As per the latest buzz, “We promoted Adipurush without watching the movie before its rollout, and that movie depicted certain things from Ramayana inaccurately. We don't want to repeat the same mistake since Ramayana belongs to billions of people,” he told PTI. The Mahasangh claimed it had received information suggesting that Ramayana contained scenes that could hurt the religious sentiments of Hindus in India and abroad. The makers were also warned that if the request was not accepted and the movie was rolled out without such a screening, the Mahasangh, along with other Hindu organisations, would stage protests and demonstrations outside cinema halls in Delhi and other states

Rajpal Yadav's two Shahjahanpur properties will as per reports be auctioned on September 9 as the bank seeks to recover dues in a Rs 16.61 crores loan case.
Adding to this, The latest development comes as the star's cheque-bounce case remains unresolved.

Meanwhile, As per the report, the Central Bank of India, Mumbai, has issued official auction notices for two properties owned by Rajpal Yadav. One property is located in Shahjahanpur city, while the other is situated in a nearby village.

Bank records as per reports show that the Shahjahanpur assets include agricultural land and a house in a village, along with another property in the city.

Based on this arrangement, the bank has as per reports proceeded with action against the mortgaged properties.
Apart from the Shahjahanpur properties, the report also suggests that the process of auctioning some of Rajpal Yadav's properties in Mumbai is currently underway.

title: Huma Qureshi breaks silence on wedding rumours: Shaadi jab honi hai tab…
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Huma Qureshi has lately made headlines on both the personal and professional fronts. While she turned producer with of late rolled out Baby Do Die Do, which clashed with Alia Bhatt’s Alpha in theatres, her appearances with star and acting coach Rachit Singh have also fuelled wedding speculation.

Adding to this, Huma Qureshi Qureshi, however, says marriage will have to wait. “You and my mum have the same questions! I don’t have an answer to when the wedding is going to happen. Shaadi jab honi hogi tab ho jayegi; I have a lot of work to do. This is a very busy year and, right now, I am just focusing on that.”

Meanwhile, It is a high-risk, high-reward business. It is exciting because you get to be the creator and keeper of your IP. I feel every creative person should produce a movie once to understand the entire process.

Notably, As an star, your job is largely in front of the camera. A producer, however, is responsible for everything needed to make a project happen. Sometimes, even somebody’s temperament becomes your problem.
As per the latest buzz, It is a humbling experience and teaches you the value of time, money and professionalism. At the same time, the risk involved is considerable.

In further updates, As actors, we are dependent on other people to hire us. Saqib (Saleem, brother- star) and I are not cribbers, and we do not like playing victims over the roles we are not getting. The only option was to create opportunities for ourselves.

On top of that, Saleem Siblings is our little brother-sister cottage industry, through which we hope to create interesting projects with like-minded people. We may not have mammoth budgets, but not every story needs ₹ 150 crore rupees to be made. Some stories need only a fraction of that amount and can still be engaging. Baby Do Die Do is now in its fifth weekend and continues to get shows. I keep sharing whenever a show goes houseful in any part of the country.

Delhi, of course, is home. I have spent my entire life there. So I don’t need an excuse to come back. But when I was there of late to promote Baby Do Die Do, I toured with the movie. We went to theatres to ask people, ‘What do you think of the movie?’ These were all surprise visits. So, sometimes I would just bump into an old friend from college or an aunty who used to be my neighbour.

title: Sharvari: I hope people remember who I played more than they remember how much the film earned
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

When Sharvari joins us on a call between shots for her next movie with Ali Abbas Zafar opposite Ahaan Panday, she is already immersed in a new world. But the glow of Main Vaapas Aaunga hasn't quite faded and why would it? Weeks after rollout, the movie continues to draw audiences, proving that sometimes the biggest hits aren't manufactured, they are discovered.

Adding to this, Outfit: Gucci, Jewellery: Reva by PNGS "It's still a pinch-me moment," she smiles. "We are in our fifth week in theatres, if I'm not mistaken. That's a really long run. especially today." For Sharvari, the movie's success feels sweeter because it wasn't fueled by hype-it was powered by people.

Meanwhile, "You can never predict how deeply a movie will connect. This kind of organic love and word of mouth is something you can't ask for. It has to come from the audience. I'm just really grateful that the movie resonated with them. There's nothing more rewarding.

Notably, The journey, however, wasn't all celebration. The first few days after rollout were nerve-racking, with the team watching months of hard work unfold at the ticket-window. Sharvari chose optimism over panic. "I have always been a positive person," she says. "I genuinely believed this movie would find its audience.

As per the latest buzz, Call it intuition or just a gut feeling, but something in my heart kept saying, kuch toh accha hoga." Her birthday arrived just two days after the rollout, giving her one more reason to believe luck was on her side.

In further updates, Today, that faith has come full circle. Followers have stopped calling her Sharvari and started calling her Jia, the character she played in the movie-a compliment every star secretly hopes for.

On top of that, "I have become much more confident over the years," she says. “Earlier, I probably wouldn't have taken as many risks. Now I enjoy experimenting while staying true to myself because fashion should feel like an extension of your personality, not a costume.”

View this post on Instagram Ironically, fashion wasn't always on her radar. "My sister Kasturi deserves all the credit," she laughs. "She's three years older than me. I was a complete tomboy while she loved dressing up, jewellery, long hair-everything I wasn't interested in. I was usually out playing sports." “That changed soon enough." I slowly started started steal stealing her earrings and dresses, which led to many controversial sibling fights. Growing up, the only person I wanted to copy was my sister."

title: Pakistani singer Mustafa Zahid to record Tera Mera Rishta for Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 despite boycott?
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nearly two decades ago, the song Tera Mera Rishta emerged as one of the most popular songs from Emraan Hashmi 's Awarapan . Now, with the sequel arriving next week in theatres, the makers might be reuniting with its original singer soon. Pakistani singer Mustafa Zahid is as per reports in talks with filmmakers Mukesh Bhatt and Vishesh Bhatt to make a remake of the song for Awarapan 2 . This would be one of the rare instances of a cross-border association in music at a time when Pakistan-based artistes have been staying away from Hindi movies.

Adding to this, Mustafa Zahid is as per reports in talks with the makers of Awarapan 2. Mustafa Zahid is as per reports in talks with the makers According to a Mid-day report, Mustafa Zahid is in talks with the producers of Awarapan 2 for a remake of the song, Tera Mera Rishta. The move has come as a surprise because after the 2016 terror attack in Uri, the Indian movie industry refused to cast artistes from Pakistan. Similarly, after the 2025 terror attack in Pahalgam, the movie industry reiterated its stance.

Meanwhile, Despite the ongoing boycott, discussions between Mustafa Zahid and the makers are still underway. If both sides reach an agreement, the song is expected to be recorded in Dubai. Sharing details about the plan, a source close to the development told Mid-day, “Should the deal materialise, it will mark one of the rare instances in recent years of a Pakistani playback singer recording for a mainstream Hindi movie. The song won't be used in Awarapan 2 as that may land the movie in certification trouble. So, the makers are considering bypassing its theatrical use; it will be used only in social media-led promotions. The professional reunion is awaiting approval from both parties at this stage.”

Notably, Awarapan 2's official trailer dropped on August 6 and featured Emraan as Shivam Pandit after 19 years since the cult classic. The trailer features the return of Shivam and with much more drama in store for viewers. Revenge, redemption, and unfinished fights have been promised by the makers of the movie. Emraan will be playing the older and more traumatised version of the character.

As per the latest buzz, Disha Patani makes her way into the franchise playing Zara in the new movie. Shabana Azmi plays Nafisa who is the main antagonist. The movie also features a supporting cast consisting of Puran Gabbi (Zorawar), Anirudh Rawal (Sikandar), Surendar Vicky (Jaideep), Vijayant Kohli (Mehmood), and Atul Kumar (Samarth).

In further updates, Music has always been a defining part of the Awarapan universe, and the sequel continues that tradition. The soundtrack has been composed by Mithoon, Jeet Gannguli, Amaal Malik, Ankit Sachdev and Wasif Ahmad, with lyrics by Sayeed Qadri, Rashmi Virag, Akhil Sachdeva and Sachin Singh Chandel. Songs such as Ve Junoon, Yeh Awarapan and Toh Phir Aao have already been rolled out, with more tracks expected soon.

On top of that, The trailer also features a recreated version of Tera Mera Rishta, composed by Mithoon and sung by Saaj Bhatt and Subodhh Sharma. The song plays throughout the trailer, adding an emotional touch to the action-packed visuals. Original lyricist Sayeed Qadri has returned to write the new version alongside Mithoon.

Presented by Mukesh Bhatt and Vishesh Films, Awarapan 2 is produced by Vishesh Bhatt, directed by Nitin Kakkar and written by Bilal Siddiqui. The movie is scheduled to rollout in cinemas worldwide on August 14, 2026, with Pen Marudhar handling its All India theatrical distribution. It will face Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 during the Independence Day weekend.
